patterns: AI agent runs a real-world errand, shown on a real recording: petergyang's Grok Bot negotiating with Comcast on a live call (572.2K) and its funniest line (356.3K, 1,209 likes), far above his previous tracked best of 55.5K

Running a company with agents: gregisenberg 'running a company nowadays feels kinda dystopian', talking to agents more than people, voice notes first (82.7K, 2,533 bookmarks) and testing products with synthetic users (14.7K); Teknium on Nous Portal subs now including a cloud agent (37.0K) and the Hermes Agent mobile app waitlist (23.7K)
Open numbers on what it costs to run a business: levelsio total business expenses down to about $300 a month (190.9K, 2,366 bookmarks)

AI used for real research and review: emollick on a mass replication of old LLM findings with new models (93.2K, 752 bookmarks), an Opus 5.5 movie from one prompt (33.9K) and AI-assisted paper review (20.7K)

Plain human advice still wins: SahilBloom 'your best years don't have to be behind you' (104.2K, 3,398 likes), dickiebush on leaving the phone at home (12.1K), businessbarista on traits of the best people he has worked with (10.6K)

Small, practical AI stories travel when they are visual and concrete: CodeByPoonam on a man using ChatGPT to find a lost earbud among rocks (5.9K); businessbarista on build vs buy now that software costs less to build (6.8K)
Recurring words today: Grok Bot, agents, voice note, Opus 5.5, Hermes, dystopian

Flagged, do not reply: levelsio Learjet 60 FAA post (230.1K, tragedy follow-up), levelsio Spanish train quote (41.2K, government), petergyang quote of an adult-product launch (128.9K); techinasia Maribank post (396.7K views, 5 likes) looks paid, skipped

Four posts are flagged and kept out of the safe lists (three do-not-reply, one likely paid). Indochina: Cambodia hosts an ASEAN symposium on AI disinformation and synthetic media from 4 Nov; Thai film executives expect AI to cut film-crew demand 40-50% over 3-5 years; Vietnam's science minister set out three AI commitments including Vietnamese-language models; no newer Laos story than FAO's LAHIS animal-health pilot, which stays on the list.

indochina_ai.title: Cambodia hosts a two-day ASEAN symposium in Phnom Penh from 4 Nov on AI-generated disinformation and synthetic media, co-organised by the Ministry of Information with German and Swiss partners; policymakers, tech firms, academics and civil society discuss media literacy, fact-checking and cooperation with tech platforms (government-led regulation and media-literacy topic, neutral)

Thai film executives expect AI to cut demand for film and post-production crew by 40-50% over 3-5 years while directors and writers stay essential; Draconic plans a Thai-Chinese AI-hybrid feature for 2027 at about half the usual budget (15M vs 30M baht), part of the 'one-man corporation' trend
